scope: Eleven transcript batches, three subsequent batches and the associated extraction, queue and source-review files present on the pinned revision.
coverage_assessment: The reference-specimen additions are low-blower level readings in an already fully credited axis and a repeat service-IAS glide trace with no new identified stall or calibrated airspeed. All remaining records have other specimen, configuration or measurement scope. The six-axis 13-variant scores receive zero additional points.

reviewed_artifacts.review: 21 variant and rating entries retained in the submitted analysis export. The original claims serve as source leads unless matched and checked.
Keep all original ranges with the existing source review. Different power and flap conditions cannot form one stall-speed range.
Keep the three-family draft with checked originals and unresolved attributions. Existing selected speeds carry the applicable grade.

Retained the 21-entry Gemini extract as submitted. Its generic Cd0, power, propeller-efficiency and mass assumptions need matching test conditions. See the linked source review for checked stall values.
Reused the existing catalog stall records and the previous source review. Calculated and IAS stall references keep their original evidence grades.

Retained P-47M/N and Tempest/Thunderbolt comparison leads. Aggregate high-speed figures need their exact report and test conditions. They supply no new 41-5902 or 43-3441 data.

Already integrated through the matched-climb data pack and shared-climb research candidate. Retained as context without duplicating rows.
